subject: general
question: Which among the following is located in the state of Arunachal Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Tawang Monastery.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__.**

__
 
• Tawang Monastery is the second biggest and oldest in Asia and is known as the** Tawang Ganden Namgyal Lhatse.**
 
• Tawang Monastery, located in** Tawang city of Tawang district** in the Indian state of** Arunachal Pradesh, is the largest monastery in India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Diskit Monastery **
 
• It is also known as Deskit Gompa or Diskit Gompa is the oldest and largest Buddhist monastery (gompa) in the Nubra Valley of Ladakh, northern India
 
• **Hemis Monastery**
 
• It is situated around 45 kms to the south of Leh on the western banks of the Indus River.
 
• The Hemis Monastery is the biggest and very richly endowed monastery of Laddakh.
 
• It was built in 1630.
 
• **Thiksey Monastery**
 
• Thikse Gompa or Thikse Monastery is a gompa affiliated with the Gelug sect of Tibetan Buddhism
